responsibility: Prepare a user-reviewed Arch Studio bug report or feature request for GitHub. Use when the user runs /as:studio-feedback, says "report a bug", "this skill broke", "send feedback", or requests a feature. Do not use for Claude Code's native /feedback command.
inputs: Supplied task and selected source scope; exact destination only for requested persistence or application work. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Only when reading an actual installed package manifest or local metadata file; delivered MCP release metadata and known host metadata do not require local file or process access.
